title: Read an immutable evidence revision
responsibility: Build a source context pinned to an exact commit and recognize safe stored evidence paths.

inputs.name: hubEvidencePath.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative candidate for a stored evidence path, checked only as text and never resolved against a tree, so a path that passes may still be missing from the repository. It has no length cap, and spaces and non-ASCII characters are accepted.

inputs.name: hubPinnedSource.base
inputs.description: Source context whose source adapter, repository, cache and identity carry into the result: the adapter's resolve must return commit, its tree call supplies the entries, and the identity is copied with requestedRef replaced. Its own commit and entries are never read, because the result replaces both.

inputs.name: hubPinnedSource.commit
inputs.description: Full commit ID to pin the context to, which must be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Any other form, such as a short SHA, uppercase hex or a branch or tag name, throws invalid-evidence-revision before the source is consulted, and so does any commit for which base.source.resolve returns a different commit.

outputs.name: hubPinnedSource
outputs.description: Promise of a context for exactly commit: source, repository and cache are shared with base, commit is set to commit, entries is the tree that base.source.tree returns for commit, and identity is base.identity copied with requestedRef set to commit. It fulfills only when base.source.resolve returns a revision whose commit equals commit, and otherwise it rejects with invalid-evidence-revision.

outputs.name: hubEvidencePath
outputs.description: True when the path is nonempty, holds no backslash and no control or delete character (U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F), and every slash-separated segment is non-empty and neither '.' nor '..'; false otherwise. It reads only the text, so true does not prove that anything exists at that path in the repository.

errors.name: invalid-evidence-revision
errors.description: Thrown by hubPinnedSource through hubFail when commit is not 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or when base.source.resolve returns a commit that differs from commit. It is thrown before base.source.tree is called, so no entries are read.
